description: The two pie charts, titled "All Changes" and "All Errors", display the distribution of categories represented by different colors. Each chart is divided into 5 slices, labeled as P (light green), PW (dark green), RW (yellow), N (light blue), and NW (dark blue). In the "All Changes" chart, the slices represent approximately 50% for P, 4% for PW, 26% for RW, 14% for N, and 5% for NW, with percentage labels displayed outside the chart. Similarly, the "All Errors" chart shows approximately 56% for P, 3% for PW, 29% for RW, 6% for N, and 5% for NW. A legend on the right side of the image provides a key to the color coding used in both charts. The slices in both charts are not visually emphasized or ordered in a particular way.
